compute_area: compute the area of bounding boxes from a numpy array with shape [N, 4]
compute_intersection: compute pairwise intersection areas between two sets of bounding boxes
compute_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two collections of bounding boxes
compute_ioa: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two collections of bounding boxes
review_np_box_ops: review the np_box_ops module for bounding box area, intersection, IOU, and IOA operations
